The Chinese government encourages new energy vehicle enterprises to carry out technological innovation by {{blank}} capital investment and {{blank}} policy guidance, thereby helping them continuously improve the competitiveness of their products in the market.

back_content.text: The Chinese government encourages new energy vehicle enterprises to carry out technological innovation by increasing capital investment and providing policy guidance, thereby helping them continuously improve the competitiveness of their products in the market.
